budget_items.topic: Underground Fire Alarm Wiring Replacement low bid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Elm Electrical of Westfield, MA was the low bid for the fire alarm wiring replacement, accepted by the board.
budget_items.quote: elm electrical from westfield, ma was low bid in the amount of $30,103.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated cost of a concrete pad with a gas-fed standby generator was given as a range.
Seven months into the fiscal year, rents were budgeted at one figure and received at a higher figure.
Maintenance labor was behind budget, expected to even out next month; weekend COVID sanitizing was added to this.
budget_items.quote: maintenance labor behind $6,779, should even out by next month

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The operating surplus for the period was reported.
The healthy reserve was reported at 74.35%, with DHCD preferring 35% or over; the board will look at what reserves can be spent on.
The State has money for the housing authority's COVID-related expenses; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: the state has some money for our covid related expenses

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Staff explained capital projects are funded by State Formula Funding, with smaller projects sometimes paid from reserves; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: receive formula funding through the state for capital improvement projects

budget_items.topic: Moving deck replacement to fund generator
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of moving the deck replacement planned for next year to fund the generator installation; no amount beyond the generator estimate.
